concept: A fast, confident developer-tool spot that treats MCP tooling as a single continuous pipeline instead of four separate chores. Open on the name and the problem (MCP needed a front door), state the thesis in one breath (one sdk to build, one cloud to ship), prove the sdk and the architecture are real with a typed terminal and a draw-on diagram, let the founder explain the actual motivation in his own words, pay it off with a one-word emotional burst that resolves his 'plumbing' language, then sign off on the wordmark with a tagline that rhymes with the open.
money_shot_note: Scene 6 (flash, 'no more plumbing') is the peak at ~74% of runtime: the only color-inverted, full-bleed accent beat in the video, landing the hardest sub_impact hit, and it's a direct callback to the founder's own quote one scene earlier -- payoff, not just volume.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts throughout (the invisible, confident default) -- no stylized boundary effect on any cut. The impact comes entirely from the sub_impact foley hit and the accent-burst color of the flash scene itself, not from a transition gimmick.
music_direction: Electronic, mid-tempo, confident. A low pad is allowed to build under the diagram and quote scenes so the flash hit has somewhere to land; cuts lead the beat by one frame throughout.

scenes.intent: establish the project name as the X poster frame and open on the problem MCP tooling never solved
scenes.copy_note: headline is the literal project name; eyebrow poses the plumbing problem as a question of missing infrastructure

scenes.intent: state the whole thesis in one breath before any proof is shown
scenes.copy_note: second line (the cloud half of the claim) carries the accent color as the newer, more distinctive piece
scenes.sound_cue: sub_impact hit under the hard cut

scenes.intent: prove the sdk is real by typing the two actual documented install commands
scenes.copy_note: both lines are verified, sourced commands at typewriter pace, nothing invented
scenes.sound_cue: sub_impact hit, typewriter clicks under the typing

scenes.intent: show the real architecture as one continuous pipeline instead of four separate tools
scenes.copy_note: the cloud node carries the accent glow as the newest, most distinctive stop on the pipeline
scenes.sound_cue: sub_impact hit, low synth pad starts building

scenes.intent: let the founder explain the real motivation in his own words before the payoff lands
scenes.copy_note: attributed, verbatim, sourced quote -- the one deliberately still, human beat in the video
scenes.sound_cue: pad sustains, energy pulls back ahead of the peak

scenes.intent: land the emotional payoff: the plumbing problem from the quote is resolved in one accent-burst word
scenes.copy_note: direct callback to the quote's own language, resolved -- the video's one inverted, full-bleed bright beat
scenes.sound_cue: sub_impact hit at full weight, the loudest moment in the mix
scenes.transition: hard cut, hardest hit of the video

scenes.intent: sign off on the wordmark with a tagline that rhymes with the open, inviting the autoloop to replay clean
scenes.copy_note: tagline echoes the open's 'front door' framing from a different angle, not verbatim
scenes.sound_cue: track resolves under a sheen pass
